input.content:
Thanks, Lucas — you're verified! One important note before we proceed: cancellation applies to an entire order, not individual items. So if the order containing the bookshelf and jigsaw puzzle includes only those two items, I can cancel the whole order for you.

Could you provide the order id (it starts with '#W')? And also let me know the reason for the cancellation — either 'no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake'. If you don't have the order id handy, just say so and I can look through your orders to find it.
